reason: Trigger test L6 (evidence/c13-trigger-go-2026-6609, lab/trigger/go-2026-6609): GET /openapi/v2 with a Range header of N one-byte ranges reaches http.ServeContent (kube-openapi handler.go:172). Vulnerable arms (official v1.28.2 go1.20.8; same source with go1.26.8) answer 206 for every N and spend 0.66-0.78 s CPU and send 7.1 MB per 600 KB request at N=50000 (linear: 0.09 s at N=5000). The fixed arm (same source, go1.26.9) answers 200 with flat CPU (0.02 s). Needs an authenticated client: anonymous /openapi/v2 is 403. Impact is bounded by the 1 MB header limit.
